name: fix-with-replay
description: Fix a control-loop problem in a new worktree: plan, then an implement and review loop with the reviewer last. Stops before committing.

steps.prompt:
Create a git worktree for branch {{branch}} under .worktrees/ (git worktree add .worktrees/<name> -b {{branch}} origin/main). Never commit on main. Print the absolute worktree path.

Then delete any artefacts left by a previous run so the review gate cannot pass on stale data: rm -f /Users/willc/Projects/gw-charger-controller/.agents/tasks/fix-plan.md /Users/willc/Projects/gw-charger-controller/.agents/tasks/fix-verification.md /Users/willc/Projects/gw-charger-controller/.agents/tasks/fix-review.md /Users/willc/Projects/gw-charger-controller/.agents/tasks/fix-review.json. Confirm with ls that none of them exist before finishing.

Plan the fix for: {{task}}

Read the steering files in .kiro/steering and AGENTS.md. Work in the worktree for branch {{branch}} under .worktrees/. The plan must include a replay test built with the incident-replay skill that fails on main. Write the plan to /Users/willc/Projects/gw-charger-controller/.agents/tasks/fix-plan.md.

Implement the plan in /Users/willc/Projects/gw-charger-controller/.agents/tasks/fix-plan.md for task: {{task}}, in the worktree for branch {{branch}}. If /Users/willc/Projects/gw-charger-controller/.agents/tasks/fix-review.json exists, read it and the review document it references and fix every finding first. Run the verification commands from the dev-workflow steering and record the results in /Users/willc/Projects/gw-charger-controller/.agents/tasks/fix-verification.md. Do NOT commit or push.

Review the uncommitted changes in the worktree for branch {{branch}} against /Users/willc/Projects/gw-charger-controller/.agents/tasks/fix-plan.md and AGENTS.md. Do not re-run the test suite; rely on /Users/willc/Projects/gw-charger-controller/.agents/tasks/fix-verification.md. Checklist: Standby untouched (no EV Modbus I/O in Standby); no per-cycle register reads added; battery sign convention unchanged; app/control/breaker.py untouched; new tests fail on main (evidence recorded); tests and ruff pass. Write the review to /Users/willc/Projects/gw-charger-controller/.agents/tasks/fix-review.md, then the gate file /Users/willc/Projects/gw-charger-controller/.agents/tasks/fix-review.json shaped {"verdict": "APPROVED" | "CHANGES_REQUESTED", "findings": [...], "reviewDoc": "/Users/willc/Projects/gw-charger-controller/.agents/tasks/fix-review.md"}. Convey the verdict only through that file and finish with send_message severity 'success'.
